text:
[issue by programaus]
### Steps to Reproduce the Bug

Open AE2 Terminal (_Crafting Terminal or normal Terminal, does not work with Pattern Encoding or Pattern Access terminal_),
or Beyond Dimensions terminal,
Search something in the JEI side tab,
Clicking off causes terminal search bar to be selected, and it cannot be unselected other than by clicking the bar itself (whereas I can just click off the JEI search bar)

### Expected Behavior

Terminal search bar remains unselected

### Actual Behavior

Terminal search bar is selected

### Mod Pack URL (Optional)

_No response_

### Mod Pack Version (Optional)

_No response_

### Extra Notes (Optional)

Mods/Versions:
JEI 19.27.0.340
Applied Energistics 19.2.17 AND/OR Beyond Dimensions 0.6.9-1.21.1
Neoforge 21.1.218
(other mods were used during secondary testing but I have tested without them beforehand)

Latest JEI version as of writing this: 19.27.0.340
The version the bug DOESNT occur on: 19.21.1.304
^ this isnt the newest working version but all the other JEI versions crash.. soo..

video showcase:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/57349bda-d8c3-4f60-8ea0-bb2712b0553a
